status: Released for printing as one complete set of four parts. Geometry checks pass; physical fit, grip and print accuracy are unverified, and the robot clearances are against an estimated mock-up.
contains: US-NECK-CLAMP-R001 clamp-u.stl and clamp-bar.stl, byte-identical, with the enclosure back and the Pi case.
approval: The user approved the clamp-and-enclosure concept (views of skellycad 3ff9794), relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-02. On 2026-11-03 the coordinator relayed the request for all four parts in one checkpoint.

source.file_names: The r005 run wrote the Pi case as omt-case-cut.stl; this checkpoint names it pi-case-30mm.stl, and the builder uses the same name from this checkpoint on. The bytes are unchanged.

clamp-u.stl.part: Clamp U with the dovetail tongue
clamp-u.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end, tube channel vertical, dovetail tongue on the back; as exported.

clamp-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, with the four screw-head recesses facing up; as exported.

enclosure-back.stl.part: Enclosure back with the dovetail channel, Pi case lips, PCA9685 wing and tie tab
enclosure-back.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as exported. Add a 5 mm brim.
enclosure-back.stl.supports: Under the dovetail block only: it starts 22 mm above the bed and sticks out 9 mm. Support on build plate only; keep supports out of the dovetail channel.

pi-case-30mm.stl.part: Pi case, 30 mm deep (already shortened in the CAD), from the OMT Raspberry Pi 5 case
pi-case-30mm.stl.orientation: Floor on the bed, open side up; as exported.
pi-case-30mm.stl.supports: none; the wall openings print as bridges, the longest 54 mm

print_settings.supports: Enclosure back only, under the dovetail block; none for the other parts

estimate.method: Not sliced. Printed volume from the model: a 1.4 mm shell plus 40 % infill, 130 cm3 in total, PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 8 mm3/s (fast current printer) to 3 mm3/s (older printer).

hardware.item: M3 x 25 mm socket-head screw (25 to 35 mm fits)
M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm across flats
hardware.use: 4 in the U side slots, 1 on the lock pin
Lock pin through the 32.6 mm enclosure block, below the tongue
Front face of the enclosure back, through the case floor and the Pi, into the AI HAT+ spacers

hardware.item: M2.5 x 16 mm spacer, supplied with the AI HAT+ [@raspberrypi2024AiHatBrief]
hardware.use: Pi to AI HAT+; assumed threaded at both ends
PCA9685 into the printed 2.4 mm pilots; a longer screw comes through the wing toward the case

hardware.item: Zip tie, up to 4.8 mm wide
hardware.use: Wire bundle through the tie-tab slots

measure_before_printing: Bare spine tube between the shoulder piece and the neck drive: at least 70 mm (the mock-up assumes 85 mm).
How far the neck drive and the shoulder piece stick out behind the back face of the tube: no more than 12 mm (the enclosure back passes 15.3 mm behind the tube).
placement: Leave 9 mm between the top of the U and the bottom of the neck drive.

interfaces.tube: 1 inch (25.4 mm) square tube; 0.3 mm clearance per side; the bar closes a 1 mm gap when tightened
interfaces.dovetail: Tongue root 16, tip 22, depth 6, height 50; mates the enclosure back channel (0.3 mm clearance)

robot_clearance_mm.basis: Estimated mock-up (designs/ultraskelly/src/mockup.json), with the U 9 mm below the neck drive. The case is checked as its bounding box; the lock pin and both HATs are included.
robot_clearance_mm.NeckDrive_note: The enclosure plate passes 3.0 mm behind the drive; the top of the dovetail block is 5.0 mm below it.

first_check.placement: U top 5 mm below the neck drive (r006)
first_check.change: The 1.0 mm neck-drive gap was below 3 mm; placing the clamp 4 mm lower raises it and keeps the other gaps at 3 mm or more.

not_established: robot geometry: the shoulder piece, neck drive, ribcage, jaw and skull are an estimated mock-up
printed dimensions, the tube and dovetail fits, the nut slots and the M2.5 threads in the PCA9685 bosses
clamp grip and slip resistance on the tube
whether one M3 pin holds the enclosure while the robot moves
Motor HAT spacer height (11 mm estimated) and the AI HAT+ spacer threads
wiring: drawn schematically; cable lengths and the bundle route
Pi 5 and AI HAT+ temperatures in the case
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced
